title: Credit Administration Memorandum — Advance Rate on Insured Growing Crops by Coverage Level, Operating Lines of Credit
content:
On a borrowing base certificate of the Operating Lines of Credit, the advance rate on insured growing crops turns on the line's crop-year assigned policy and its coverage level.

## Rule

The crop-year assigned policy is a Crop Insurance policy in active status for the line's crop year whose indemnity is assigned to the association for this line. Insured growing crops on the certificate are lent against at:

- **70 percent** when the line has a crop-year assigned policy whose coverage level is at least 80 percent;
- **zero** when the line has no crop-year assigned policy, or that policy's coverage level is below the product's minimum coverage level;
- **the product's own advance rate on insured growing crops** when the line has a crop-year assigned policy whose coverage level is at least the product's minimum coverage level but below 80 percent.

## Figures by product

| Product | Minimum coverage level | Rate at coverage of 80% or more | Rate at coverage from the minimum up to but not including 80% | Rate below the minimum or with no assigned policy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 70% | 70% | 0% (product rate) | 0% |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 0% | 70% | 0% (product rate) | 0% (no policy) |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 70% | 70% | 0% (product rate) | 0% |
| Revolving Operating Line | 0% | 70% | 0% (product rate) | 0% (no policy) |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 65% | 70% | 65% (product rate) | 0% |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 0% | 70% | 60% (product rate) | 0% (no policy) |

Where the minimum coverage level is 0%, any crop-year assigned policy is at or above it, so only the absence of such a policy gives zero.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical Borrowing Base Operating Line certificates)

| Crop-year assigned policy | Coverage level | Advance rate on insured growing crops |
|---|---|---|
| Held | 80% | 70% |
| Held | 79% | 65% |
| Held | 65% | 65% |
| Held | 64% | 0% |
| Policy active for the crop year, indemnity not assigned to this line | 85% | 0% — not a crop-year assigned policy |
| None | — | 0% |

## Questions on the rule

**Does a policy for last year's crop count?** No. Only a policy for the line's own crop year, in active status, assigned to this line, is a crop-year assigned policy.

**Is a coverage level of exactly 80 percent enough for the 70 percent rate?** Yes; the rate applies at a coverage level of at least 80 percent.
